description: This file contains implementation of SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) socket functionalities, including Payload handling, PDU serialization/deserialization, and related methods within the Bluetooth namespace.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Handles the construction and reading of SDP payload descriptors.

classes.name: PDU
classes.description: Represents a Protocol Data Unit for SDP, with methods for serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: Payload::PushDescriptor
methods.description: Constructs and pushes a descriptor of a given type and size into the payload buffer.

methods.name: Payload::ReadDescriptor
methods.description: Reads a descriptor's type and size from the payload buffer.

methods.name: PDU::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the PDU into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: PDU::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a PDU object, handling truncated messages.
